'''Leek soup''', or usually '''leek and potato soup''', is common to the cuisines of many places. It is made from [[leek (vegetable)|leeks]] and other vegetables simmered in water or stock. It usually includes potatoes, and sometimes onions and garlic. It may be enriched with milk or cream. It is usually served hot; chilled, it is the basis of [[vichyssoise]].
